## Structure and components

- [statement] The source CLGaugeFactory defaults are DEFAULT_MIN_STAKE_BLOCKS = 5 and a DEFAULT_PENALTY_RATE equal to MAX_PIPS. Gauge divides the penalty by MAX_PIPS imported from contracts/libraries/ProtocolConstants.sol, where that constant represents 100%, so the default early reward forfeit is the entire reward. Gauge applies the rate when the current block is below depositBlock plus minStakeBlocks. This is a block window, not a fixed wall-clock duration, and these defaults are not an attestation of current live configuration. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/main/contracts/gauge/CLGaugeFactory.sol · keywords: Aero smart-contract and API integration · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/main/contracts/gauge/Gauge.sol, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/main/contracts/gauge/CLGauge.sol, https://github.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/blob/main/contracts/libraries/ProtocolConstants.sol

## How it works

- [statement] The interface NatSpec assumes an existing initialized pool, but the implementation additionally calls createPool when sqrtPriceX96 is nonzero. For an existing pool, set sqrtPriceX96 to zero; the factory requires the pool mapping to be empty before creation. The implementation therefore supports a creation branch omitted by that NatSpec. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-05) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/main/contracts/periphery/interfaces/INonfungiblePositionManager.sol · keywords: Aero smart-contract and API integration · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/main/contracts/periphery/NonfungiblePositionManager.sol, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/main/contracts/core/CLFactory.sol

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] CLGauge inherits deposit(uint256) and withdraw(uint256) from Gauge. Reward calls are claimEmissions(address,address) and claimEmissions(address,address,uint256[]), authorized for the account or an approved claim operator. Verify reward-claim method names against this ABI instead of importing them from legacy Slipstream integrations. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-05) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/main/contracts/gauge/Gauge.sol · keywords: Aero smart-contract and API integration · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/main/contracts/gauge/CLGauge.sol
- [statement] The docs describe CL1, CL50, CL100, CL200 and CL2000. Independently decoding the Base deployment clFactoryConstructorArgs as ABI words yields seven initial tick-spacing and fee entries, including intermediate classes and no CL2000 entry. CLFactory enables the initial fee tiers passed to its constructor. These published artifacts disagree; query the target factory for currently enabled spacings instead of using the documentation table as an exhaustive allowlist. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-05) — https://app.aero.xyz/docs/features/slipstream · keywords: Aero smart-contract and API integration · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/main/deployment-addresses/cl-base.json, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/main/contracts/core/CLFactory.sol
- [statement] The dynamic hook caches a block-wide fee set on the first swap in each block. Unless the pool's configured base fee is ZERO_FEE_INDICATOR, that first swap recomputes the dynamic component from recent oracle tick history and stores the base fee plus that dynamic component, capped at the fee cap; a zero base fee falls back to the tick-spacing fee. When the base fee is ZERO_FEE_INDICATOR, the first swap instead uses and stores the static tick-spacing fee and computes no dynamic component. Caller discounts and initial-transaction handling can alter the applied fee, and beforeSwap adds the MEV module fee. The tick-spacing fee is therefore an input to the charged fee rather than a fixed execution quote. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dromos-labs/metadex-public/main/V3/src/hooks/dynamic/DynamicSwapFeeHook.sol · keywords: Aero smart-contract and API integration · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/main/contracts/core/CLFactory.sol

## Facts and statements

- [statement] The Aero Security Overview and Base deployment JSON agree on the position manager 0x4857DB576eE0e45F10525eC59527BfD10beeC60b, CL factory 0x9CB220581b91b0C83223012FE69688b92aD07a76, and CL gauge factory 0xf437f62053ACB121665b8fDBfeA8F214FB8E589d. Treat these as published deployment records; this research did not check deployed bytecode. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-05) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/main/deployment-addresses/cl-base.json · keywords: Aero smart-contract and API integration · also: https://app.aero.xyz/docs/security
- [statement] The exact mint tuple field order and types are: address token0, address token1, int24 tickSpacing, int24 tickLower, int24 tickUpper, uint256 amount0Desired, uint256 amount1Desired, uint256 amount0Min, uint256 amount1Min, address recipient, uint256 deadline, uint160 sqrtPriceX96. The payable mint returns uint256 tokenId, uint128 liquidity, uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1. Generate the ABI from this interface. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-05) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/main/contracts/periphery/interfaces/INonfungiblePositionManager.sol · keywords: Aero smart-contract and API integration
- [statement] Depositing requires NFT ownership and NFT approval to the gauge, verifies that the position tokens and tick spacing match, collects fees, and transfers custody to the gauge. A normal withdrawal attempts to claim emissions, removes staked liquidity, and returns the NFT to the caller. Finish withdrawal before using a wallet-owned position-manager removal recipe. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-05) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/main/contracts/gauge/CLGauge.sol · keywords: Aero smart-contract and API integration · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/main/contracts/gauge/Gauge.sol
- [statement] Read effectivePenaltyConfig(gauge) before planning claims or a rebalance. Factory administrators can change the common penalty rate and holding window, and gauges can have a holding-window override. The explicit claim path also applies the effective penalty through _computePositionEmissions; waiting to withdraw does not make an earlier claim penalty-free. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-05) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/main/contracts/gauge/CLGaugeFactory.sol · keywords: Aero smart-contract and API integration · also: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/main/contracts/gauge/CLGauge.sol
- [statement] The Sugar Base deployment env file publishes LP_SUGAR_ADDRESS_8453=0x69dD9db6d8f8E7d83887A704f447b1a584b599A1 and TOKEN_SUGAR_8453=0x910CD56277994B4970F49AEDA52c96aD620aE81D, but its configured voter is 0x16613524e02ad97eDfeF371bC883F2F5d6C480A5 and its CL factory list excludes Aero CLFactory 0x9CB220581b91b0C83223012FE69688b92aD07a76. Aero's published Base contract-address table instead lists Voter 0x49d7d4f17Ec56Ef8fA04E464AF5D1A4942CC31e6. These records do not establish that this Sugar deployment indexes Aero; do not certify it as Aero-compatible from the chain ID alone. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-05) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/velodrome-finance/sugar/main/deployments/base.env · keywords: Aero smart-contract and API integration · also: https://app.aero.xyz/docs/llms-full.txt
- [statement] The position-manager interface exposes decreaseLiquidity with tokenId, liquidity, amount0Min, amount1Min and deadline; collect with tokenId, recipient, amount0Max and amount1Max; and burn only after liquidity and collectible amounts are empty. A range exit therefore needs distinct decrease and collection operations. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-05) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/main/contracts/periphery/interfaces/INonfungiblePositionManager.sol · keywords: Aero smart-contract and API integration
- [statement] Viem simulateContract obtains return data and revert reasons for contract writes without changing chain state. Use it with the Aero ABI and actual caller before submitting the corresponding write; simulation is a preflight check and does not reserve the simulated state. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-05) — https://viem.sh/docs/contract/simulateContract · keywords: Aero smart-contract and API integration
